title: Bicycle Terminals at Key Locations in City and Downtown
what_it_is: Bicycle Terminals at Key Locations in City and Downtown

sections.label: Bicycle parking at MRT stations
sections.summary: There are over 800 bicycle parking lots at eight city-area MRT stations, and LTA plans parking standards and Walking and Cycling Plans for developments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In answer to the Member Mr Darryl David, there are currently more than 800 bicycle parking lots at eight Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) stations located in the city area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For the Downtown Line, which is the newest line to be operational, bicycle parking lots will be provided at a majority of the stations in the city area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) also plans to require bicycle parking standards for private residential, commercial and community developments, including those in the city area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Besides parking, developers will soon have to submit a Walking and Cycling Plan which factors in other supporting facilities for cyclists, such as showers and lockers.

sections.label: Considerations for bicycle facilities
sections.summary: Space at MRT station sites and first- and last-mile connectivity are considerations, so building owners are to implement Walking and Cycling Plans.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: One is that at the sites where the MRT stations are located, we need to have the available space in order to carry out a plan like dedicated bicycle terminals.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The second consideration is that when we provide bicycle facilities, we must bear in mind the objective, that is, first- and last-mile connectivity.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: That is why the intention is to involve building owners.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: That, ultimately, is going to be a building with an owner.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: So, we prefer to require these owners to implement Walking and Cycling Plans so that facilities can be nearer to the destinations of the bicycle users.
